description: This Java source file defines the DeviceListActivity class for an Android Bluetooth chat application. It manages listing paired and discovered Bluetooth devices, initiating device discovery, handling user selection, and broadcasting device discovery events.

classes.name: DeviceListActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a list of Bluetooth devices (paired and discovered) for user selection, and returns the selected device's MAC address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, registers broadcast receivers, and populates the list of paired devices.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by canceling discovery and unregistering broadcast receivers.

methods.name: doDiscovery
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth device discovery, updates UI to indicate scanning.
